title: check-hints/<child>.json — one child's verification check hints (authored, never derived)
description: One file per child, authored by that child's wave-2 sub-Task: children are written in parallel, so a shared file would be a write conflict. check_id is unique across all children (enforced when the files are aggregated), source_feature resolves to a features.json id (check-coverage), and implementation_detail_verbatim is the sole downstream source of cycle-accurate refmodel formulas, judged by the spec-review faithfulness lens. Field names match the scaffold's inlined_check_hints[], so the injection is a verbatim copy.

check_id.description: Unique across every child. testpoints[].covers[] refers to it.

source_feature.description: A features.json id. Every feature must be named by at least one hint.

implementation_detail.description: Short summary of what is checked.

implementation_detail_verbatim.description: The brainstorm-original RTL formula or token, uncompressed — or a plain statement that the brainstorm gives no formula. Optional in shape. Its fidelity is judged by the spec-review faithfulness lens against the WHOLE brainstorm — the only reader that can tell a compressed paraphrase from the original, and the only one that can tell whether a formula landed in the right child's hint at all.

observable.description: The signal or port the check observes.

reference_rule.description: The reference-model rule the observable is judged against.

latency.description: Optional. Cycles between stimulus and observable effect.

reset_behavior.description: Optional. The observable's value under reset.
